newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela debt will rise to 65 pct GDP - Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela debt will rise to 65 pct GDP - Matos.

text.p: Venezuela's total stock of debt will soon amount to 65 percent of GDP, from just over 40 percent now, according to finance ministry estimates released on Tuesday.
Comparing Venezuela's debt situation to that of the European Union, finance minister Luis Raul Matos said Venezuela would soon be above the EU's self-imposed upper limit of 55 percent.
"But over there, Spain, France and other countries cannot meet their targets and are discussing ways of remedying the situation," he told Congress.
The 25 percentage point rise in total debt is associated with reform of severance payments and social security, and recognition of the government's debt with the central bank, he said.
The finance ministry had forecast total debt at the end of this government to be between $22 and $23 billion, against $29 billion at the end of 1996, but this estimate now stood at $40 billion.
